title: Pinning assumes an already sustained soft mode
statement: Project the traveling force onto the phase tangent of turbulence-supplied U=A cos(kx-Omega t-theta): dtheta=[Deltaomega-kappa sin(theta-phi)]dt+sqrt(2Dtheta)dW, kappa=F0/(rho A). This is established Adler synchronization machinery with a specific conditional forcing interpretation. Zero-detuning stationary phase is von Mises exp[(kappa/Dtheta)cos(theta-phi)]/[2pi I0(kappa/Dtheta)]. Source reports concentration >=14.6028 for95% in ±30degrees. Same geometry/amplitude model P_phase/P_amplitude=kappa/(gamma+Dk²); weak phase diffusion can lower modeled power, but the physical phase response and diffusion must first be earned.

requires: Positive and negative absorbed-power profiles are independently programmable in a specified Gaussian deposition model; transfer efficiency, absorption, damping, diffusivity and width are inputs.
A turbulence-maintained mode U=A cos(kx-Omega t-theta) has a usable soft phase with acquired-in-model detuning, diffusion and force projection; this structure is not demonstrated for a reactor.

Turbulence-sustained amplitude, soft phase, programmable deposition, effective coupling and phase diffusion are supplied model inputs. Actual antenna-to-wave-to-mode susceptibility, transient dressing momentum, nonlinear heat-flux payoff and equally informed matched-control comparison remain unearned. Script preserved without execution or repair; all existing holds remain.
costs: Both nonnegative wave powers, deposition selectivity, RF absorption, momentum transfer, transient stored dressing momentum and startup are paid.

Illustrative synthetic parameters and finite discretizations are not measured calibration, feasible antenna design or a full nonlinear gyrokinetic simulation; same actuator ordinary control remains a strong comparator.
